recovery_event: one per required slot FAMILY that ever had a non-OK grounding (or a displaced/obscured slot); begins at the first non-OK status (WAITING_FOR_CLARIFICATION / REPHRASE / SCHEMA repair / REFERENCE resolution), ends when the family RESOLVES or the demonstration aborts
recovery_attempt: one teacher recovery exchange (RESTATE_SLOT / RESTATE_OBSCURED / CLARIFY_REFERENCE question for the family) or one hosted-grounder structured retry within the event
metrics: RECOVERY_TARGET_SUCCESS = learned exactly among targets with >= 1 event

INITIAL_SLOT_GROUNDING_BEHAVIORAL_EXACT: original lesson slots of faithful non-injected demonstrations: first grounding OK and the demonstration's executed program behaviourally exact (committed) or a behavioural reference prefix (not returned)
RECOVERY_SLOT_GROUNDING_BEHAVIORAL_EXACT: recovery replacement slots, RESOLVED and the same program condition
GROUNDING_BEHAVIORAL_EXACT (gate) = the parent TTP demonstration-level definition, unchanged
TEACHER_INITIAL_LESSON_BEHAVIORAL_EXACT (F, D: judge on initial lesson lines)

TEACHER_RECOVERY_RESPONSE_EXACT (E, D): a hosted recovery response is EXACT iff it is well-formed (STEP / CANCEL_SLOT / REFERENT line), its slot family resolved and the demonstration committed behaviourally exact; FORMAT_ERROR iff not well-formed; else SEMANTIC_ERROR
PROVIDER_TRUNCATION by role (initial_teacher / recovery_teacher / grounder / judge)
pooling: weighted counts across DEV-A + DEV-B; min successes = ceil(threshold x denominator); per-replicate floor .80 on each primary metric
